description: This image displays a user interface button from the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CLC+ Core application, titled "Add or delete Input Classes" in its documentation. The button is depicted with a light green rectangular outline and contains two green icons: a grid-like icon (representing a table or dataset) on the left, and a downward-pointing chevron (indicating a dropdown menu or selection) on the right. This UI element facilitates the addition or deletion of Input Classes within CLC+ Core, allowing users to select and manage datasets already ingested into the system.
